subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Should #97971 remain as a meta tracker, or should maintainers split the remaining systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff, and audit-surface work into separate canonical issues before implementation?
rationale: Current main already covers several asks, and the remaining gaps cross stable security/auth/update/audit contracts where automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary safely.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Keep this issue open only long enough to create or link narrow canonical trackers for the remaining docs, update diff, and audit-contract work.

options.title: Close after partial coverage
options.body: Close this issue because current main covers many asks, accepting that only adjacent trackers will carry the remaining gaps.

options.title: Accept one broad feature PR
options.body: Allow a contributor to implement the whole bundle in one PR, increasing review cost and compatibility/security risk across unrelated surfaces.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only long enough to create or link narrow canonical trackers for the remaining docs, update diff, and audit-contract work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history is ambiguous, but this user appears in the current-main carry-forward snapshot and related recent maintenance context, making them the best visible owner for the split/close product decision.
